same-round MatchingFailed after Reserved/Accepted does not regress state, assignment, round, version or timestamps
late reservation on a terminal MatchFailed trip is fenced (TerminalState); nothing reactivates
replayed lifecycle outcomes skip SaveChanges: Version/UpdatedAt byte-stable with full CreatedAt footprint check
cross-service agreement: Trip assignment reference equals the Driver authority row (trip, driver, reservation, round) for winner, loser-rejection and replay cases
authority: reloaded authoritative Trip PostgreSQL row (AsNoTracking) plus the authoritative Driver PostgreSQL row for agreement cases
